# Transparent assistant source image

`rhodium-dimer-transparent.png` is Wikimedia's 960-pixel PNG rendering of
[Cp*2Rh2Cl4 2023.svg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Cp*2Rh2Cl4_2023.svg),
drawn by Smokefoot (21 February 2023). The file page marks this simple chemical
structural formula as public domain (PD-chem).

Downloaded unchanged on 24 September 2026 from
<https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/16/Cp%2A2Rh2Cl4_2023.svg/960px-Cp%2A2Rh2Cl4_2023.svg.png>.

This is the drawing reported as completely black by the assistant. Its black
linework is encoded using alpha against a transparent background. Tests check
that the assistant's opaque copy retains the drawing while the source picture
keeps its transparency. The fixture does not validate molecular reconstruction.
